notes: Steps are dependency-aware and are not an unconditional linear pipeline.
Geometry facts, material semantics, and authorization for geometry-changing actions are separate records.
Repository-relative references identify the fixed baseline; ignored outputs and local absolute paths are not required inputs.

stages.purpose: Probe the exact software, kernel, binding, version, import/export, topology, Boolean, measurement, provenance-history, timeout, and error capabilities before mapping a backend.
inputs: target backend software, kernel, binding, and version
requested capability subset and operation permission
outputs: captured error, timeout, and empty-result semantics
preconditions: The exact target runtime is available without modifying production data.
Probe geometry is disposable and does not authorize operations on user inputs.
acceptance_properties: Every required capability has an explicit status and observed result.
Binding availability is measured directly rather than inferred from kernel documentation.
Software, kernel, binding, version, process boundary, and tolerance settings are recorded separately.
negative_checks: Do not infer FreeCAD Python support from an OCCT C++ symbol.
Do not count two call layers over the same OCCT kernel as independent-kernel validation.
Do not silently replace B-rep operations with mesh approximations.
failure_or_unsupported_behavior: Record missing binding functions as UNSUPPORTED with the checked symbols.
Record timeout, exception, empty result, invalid result, and unavailable history distinctly.
Stop before adapter mapping when a required truth-preserving capability is absent; optionally narrow the declared scope.
limitations: The recorded FreeCAD probe reports native_boolean_history as NOT_AVAILABLE while direct face common is AVAILABLE.
The probe is not a universal CAD conformance suite.

stages.purpose: Import Solid/Face geometry while preserving units, placement, direction, occurrence identity, source identity, validity, and closedness needed by downstream truth and provenance.
inputs: occurrence labels or an explicit occurrence locator contract
outputs: document, region, occurrence, and source-face identifiers
preconditions: Input bytes are fixed before analysis.
Occurrence identity is not derived from traversal order alone.
acceptance_properties: Analysis re-imports the tracked STEP instead of reusing generator objects.
Equal geometry at different occurrences receives distinct region identity.
Transforms or copies used by later operations do not mutate the archived originals.
negative_checks: Reject missing or ambiguous required roles instead of falling back to object order.
Do not use FaceN, random UUIDs, process counters, or list indexes as persistent identity.
Do not treat display mesh coordinates as B-rep truth.
failure_or_unsupported_behavior: Return UNSUPPORTED when the input's occurrence or role semantics cannot be recovered within the declared scope.
Return INVALID_INPUT for invalid/non-solid geometry when downstream stages require valid closed solids.
Preserve the input hash and importer diagnostics on failure.
limitations: General assembly occurrence graphs, arbitrary STEP dialects, and complete unit/placement semantics are NOT_VERIFIED.
A01 role binding is intentionally limited to explicit Side_1/Side_2 conventions.

stages.purpose: Generate conservative candidates and select corresponding interface entities without confusing proximity, supporting surfaces, material semantics, or traversal order with confirmed correspondence.
inputs: declared correspondence roles when the task depends on them
outputs: selected corresponding face pairs with method labels
preconditions: Candidate generation is separated from exact relation confirmation.
Required semantic roles are explicit before a role-constrained measure is computed.
acceptance_properties: A candidate relation never becomes a confirmed relation without G03 evidence.
Signed offset is measured between the intended corresponding interface faces and uses outward-normal semantics where required.
Ambiguous or absent correspondence fails closed.
negative_checks: Do not minimize over arbitrary parallel supporting planes when the contract requires role-constrained interfaces.
Do not treat a surface Axis as an oriented outward face normal.
Do not select by FaceN or enumeration position.
failure_or_unsupported_behavior: Return UNSUPPORTED with role_missing, role_ambiguous, or nonparallel reason when correspondence cannot be established.
Retain all candidate evidence needed to audit a wrong selection.
Do not fabricate a zero-area face for an empty selection.
limitations: There is no general automatic corresponding-interface solver for arbitrary STEP assemblies.
The A01 repair must not be generalized beyond inputs satisfying its explicit role convention.

stages.purpose: Determine exact geometric relation and intersection dimension, then measure applicable distance, length, area, and volume without collapsing exact geometry into engineering-tolerance state.
required_capabilities: distance, length, area, and volume measurement
inputs: engineering tolerance tauE when classification requires it
preconditions: G02 correspondence is sufficient for any signed measure.
Tolerance roles and units are declared before classification.
acceptance_properties: 0D, 1D, 2D, and 3D relations are distinguished.
Area and volume are only compared when applicable; positive gap keeps a zero-intersection check.
Raw and normalized errors are both retained when scale analysis is performed.
negative_checks: Do not label positive common volume as a material gap because one unrelated plane pair is separated.
Do not combine engineering tolerance, kernel tolerance, acceptance epsilon, and movement budget.
Do not call a numeric over-limit result floating-point noise without evidence or relax truth after seeing actual.
failure_or_unsupported_behavior: Return AMBIGUOUS or UNSUPPORTED for conflicting or unavailable dimension evidence.
Keep method mismatch in the denominator and preserve the measured value.
Distinguish NOT_APPLICABLE measures from missing measurements.
limitations: Arbitrary NURBS, non-manifold, noisy external, and large assembly inputs are NOT_VERIFIED.
Known 05B/05C numeric over-limit results remain part of the record.

stages.purpose: Construct and describe common regions, remaining regions, topology, coverage, and source provenance from actual geometry while retaining raw evidence.
required_capabilities: source-to-result provenance or an explicit limited fallback
inputs: area and linear epsilons with units
outputs: source mappings with provenance method and completeness status
preconditions: G03 established the relation and applicability of patch construction.
Coverage denominator is the declared participating carrier region, not an incidental raw-face partition.
acceptance_properties: For each participating face F, area(F) approximately equals area(common)+area(remainder).
Positive-area overlap between common and remainder is zero and their union stays on F.
Periodic seams do not create false semantic components; holes and disconnected components are measured geometrically.
Many-to-many source linkage is retained when one semantic patch spans multiple raw faces.
negative_checks: Do not require the same raw face count or FaceN across backends.
Do not infer provenance solely from a plausible-looking result face.
Do not emit a fake zero-area Face for an empty remainder.
failure_or_unsupported_behavior: If native face history is absent, record that capability boundary and label direct-face-common provenance separately.
If required provenance cannot be established, fail closed or narrow the accepted output scope.
Retain raw pieces when contract grouping is ambiguous.
limitations: Native Boolean Modified/Generated/Deleted history is not exposed by the probed FreeCAD binding.
Direct-face-common provenance is real but is not equivalent to full native Boolean history.

stages.purpose: Perform an optional geometry-changing operation such as cut, split, or fuse only when explicitly authorized, supported, and needed by the requested capability.
required_capabilities: cut, split/general-fuse, or fuse as requested
validity, closedness, connectedness, and material conservation checks
outputs: new result shape without mutating originals
preconditions: The task explicitly authorizes geometry modification.
G00 reports the exact operation as supported within the declared scope.
acceptance_properties: The operation uses copies and preserves original inputs for audit.
Expected truth is not used to construct or select actual operation geometry.
The final gate includes validity, closedness, connectedness, volume/material conservation, and target-shape properties.
negative_checks: Do not force Fuse for detection-only work.
Do not convert semantic activation into operation authorization.
Do not accept a wrong target merely because it is valid, closed, connected, or equal-volume.
failure_or_unsupported_behavior: Return NOT_AUTHORIZED without changing geometry when permission is absent.
Return UNSUPPORTED when the backend cannot preserve the required B-rep operation semantics.
Return FAIL with structured failed properties when the target-shape contract is not met.
limitations: No general automatic repair or movement planner is implemented.
06A is outside this baseline and is recorded as PLANNED/NOT_VERIFIED here.

stages.purpose: Validate geometry facts, material semantics, and any authorized operation independently against immutable truth and negative cases.
required_capabilities: negative candidates and fail-closed status aggregation
inputs: actual evidence written before expected truth is read
declared applicability, denominators, units, and tolerances
outputs: separate geometry, semantics, provenance, and operation verdicts
preconditions: Actual geometry evidence is immutable before expected data is loaded.
Truth source and construction independence are documented.
acceptance_properties: Mutating expected truth changes validation but never actual evidence.
Every recorded check that is required by the contract participates in the final verdict.
Cross-backend comparison uses relations, dimensions, common/remainder properties, coverage, material/void, bidirectional differences, and provenance when required.
negative_checks: Do not compare FaceN, raw face count, STEP bytes, or serialized B-rep hashes as geometric equivalence.
Do not let an expected file select actual faces or construct actual result geometry.
Do not reinterpret an old report PASS as a current or second-backend PASS.
failure_or_unsupported_behavior: Missing required actual values fail; non-applicable values are marked NOT_APPLICABLE.
Unsupported provenance or topology prevents a complete verdict rather than being silently ignored.
Samples outside their construction domain remain in the denominator but are not labeled method failures.
limitations: Existing pytest code includes FreeCAD-dependent tests and is not an out-of-the-box backend-neutral suite.
Truth inputs and acceptance properties are reusable; backend adapters and backend-internal assertions require classification and adaptation.

stages.purpose: Export, re-import, replay, and archive enough versioned evidence to reproduce the declared result without depending on a chat, an absolute drive path, or ignored local outputs.
inputs: backend, kernel, binding, and version records
outputs: versioned manifest, evidence index, and limitations
preconditions: Required G06 verdicts are complete or explicitly limited.
Every durable reference resolves from repository-relative tracked content or is labeled LOCAL_ONLY.
acceptance_properties: Original file hashes identify exact inputs; geometric equivalence and cross-process repeatability are separate checks.
Independent processes compare semantic/property snapshots rather than unstable enumeration.
If a historical output is ignored or absent, its producing commit and tracked inputs/tests/docs are used to locate it without inventing a path.
negative_checks: Do not require byte-identical STEP or B-rep serialization for equivalent shapes.
Do not cite an ignored outputs directory as the sole durable evidence source.
Do not start duplicate FreeCAD/pytest runs or report old logs as new execution.
failure_or_unsupported_behavior: Label untracked evidence LOCAL_ONLY and keep it out of claims requiring durable evidence.
Record export/re-import failures independently from in-memory geometry validation.
If a referenced historical artifact is absent, locate it through git log, commit trees, and tracked producer inputs; report absence explicitly.
limitations: Many generated outputs are intentionally not tracked; tracked summaries do not replace raw measurements.
A repository-wide archival policy for every future backend is DESIGN_ONLY.
